Name: fn_update_attendance_summary()
Description & Cross-Module Synchronizati: Calculates attended and absent sessions; computes subject attendance %; upserts attendance_summaries; automatically updates students.attendance_pct cached overall attendance across all subjects.

Name: trg_attendance_record_sync
Description & Cross-Module Synchronizati: Fires fn_update_attendance_summary() immediately when faculty confirms or alters student attendance records. Reflects in Student Dashboard donut chart and alert widgets.

Name: fn_recalculate_student_result()
Description & Cross-Module Synchronizati: Automatically maps numerical marks to grade letters (O A+ A B+ B C F) and grade points (10 to 0). Calculates semester SGPA weighted by subject credits and recalculates cumulative CGPA.

Name: trg_marks_calc_results
Description & Cross-Module Synchronizati: Fires fn_recalculate_student_result() when faculty grades marks. Automatically upserts results table with Pass/Fail status and updates students.sgpa and students.cgpa.

Name: fn_fee_payment_update()
Description & Cross-Module Synchronizati: Sums all receipts for a student fee invoice; recalculates paid_amount and due_amount; auto-updates invoice status to Paid or Partially Paid; updates students.fees_due balance.

Name: trg_fee_payment_sync
Description & Cross-Module Synchronizati: Fires fn_fee_payment_update() when an online or offline fee payment receipt is generated. Instantly reflects zero balance on Student Fees and Finance Desk.

Name: fn_calculate_library_fine()
Description & Cross-Module Synchronizati: Detects overdue book returns past due_date; computes fine at ₹5 per overdue day; posts fine charges to student billing ledger and manages inventory counts.

Name: trg_library_fine_calc
Description & Cross-Module Synchronizati: Fires fn_calculate_library_fine() whenever a book issue record status transitions to Returned or Overdue.

Name: fn_sync_placement_status()
Description & Cross-Module Synchronizati: Tracks company application status; when a student receives an offer or shortlist sets students.placement_status to Placed or Shortlisted and updates placement drive analytics.

Name: trg_placement_status_sync
Description & Cross-Module Synchronizati: Fires fn_sync_placement_status() on drive selection or application updates. Reflects instantly on student profile badge and TNP dashboard.

Name: fn_check_timetable_conflict()
Description & Cross-Module Synchronizati: Validates schedule triple-clash: 1) Class Section conflict 2) Faculty double-booking conflict 3) Room venue double-booking conflict across Monday-Saturday 9 AM to 4 PM.

Name: fn_calculate_faculty_payroll()
Description & Cross-Module Synchronizati: Computes 7th Pay basic salary (₹110000); breaks down allowances (+₹35000: DA HRA TA Grant); computes gross earnings (₹145000); computes deductions (-₹18000: PF TDS PT); computes net take-home (₹127000).

Name: v_student_attendance_summary
Description & Cross-Module Synchronizati: Computes real-time subject-wise session count attended sessions absent count and attendance turnout percentage.

Name: v_student_fee_balance
Description & Cross-Module Synchronizati: Computes total invoices billed payments received outstanding balance and standing status (Clear Partial Due).

Name: v_weekly_timetable
Description & Cross-Module Synchronizati: Joins complete 6-day academic schedule (Monday to Saturday 09:00 AM to 04:00 PM) with teacher names and classroom venues.

Name: v_faculty_enrolled_students
Description & Cross-Module Synchronizati: Provides active 25-scholar cohort list for faculty attendance registers and grading evaluations.

Name: v_library_overdue_books
Description & Cross-Module Synchronizati: Calculates unreturned book loans past due date with daily fine accrual calculation in PostgreSQL.

Name: v_faculty_workload
Description & Cross-Module Synchronizati: Summarizes allocated sections distinct subjects taught and total weekly teaching slots per professor.
